metadata.llm_reason: Candidate 4c9e6702 and peer 5c3d9b07 are semantically identical session_skill capabilities for agent session lifecycle management. Both initialize, execute, and terminate agent sessions with status reporting. The peer (AgentOps Session Lifecycle Management) is more specific and implementation-grounded (AgentOps SDK), while the candidate is generic. The peer has stronger support evidence and should be retained; the candidate should merge into it. Peers 940d307d and 6435e985 are distinct tracing and metrics capabilities, not agent session lifecycle. Existing skills (Flink streaming) are in different domains and should not be affected.
